info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Creditcard Applications Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Application Status API provides real-time insights into the status of credit card applications. This endpoint allows users to retrieve the current status of submitted applications, including approvals, rejections, and pending reviews. Financial institutions and customer service representatives typically utilize this API to enhance customer engagement and communication regarding application processes. This solution aims to streamline the application status inquiry process, ensuring applicants receive timely updates about their submissions.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the current status of applications in the system, providing essential information needed to understand their progress and state.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of applications. It must conform to the specified schema for successful processing.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the status of applications.

ListCreditcardApplicationsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body content type for the GET operation on application status, which is a string value.

status.description: Indicates the success or failure of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: Unique identifier related to the operation.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A descriptive message providing additional details about the operation.

ListCreditcardApplicationsStatusResponse.description: Response schema for retrieving the status of applications. It includes the status of the operation, relevant identifiers, processing information, and audit details.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Audit information about the application record, including who created it, when it was created, and whether the operation was automated.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the duration of the processing performed by the server for the request.

schema.description: The time taken by the server to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
